title: Wharves and Jetties Programme
summary: Design, checking and certification across a series of wharf and jetty projects, including Kupiano Wharf rehabilitation and the Kavieng, Finschhafen, Omorong and Kikori facilities.
client: PNG Ports, NMSA and other public and private clients
location: Central, East New Britain, New Ireland, Morobe and Gulf provinces
role: Design Engineer, QA/QC Check Engineer and Certifying Engineer
body:
RNL has worked on numerous wharf and jetty projects for PNG Ports, the National Maritime Safety Authority (NMSA) and other clients.

## Projects include

- Kupiano Wharf rehabilitation
- Omorong Jetty, Kokopo
- Kavieng Wharf
- Finschhafen Wharf
- Kikori Jetty

## Our role

Depending on the project, RNL acted as Design Engineer, QA/QC Check Engineer or Certifying Engineer.
